notes: MOVE unavailable; no proxy was silently substituted.
HY OAS is official daily data and lags live JNK/HYG observations.

risk_environment.rationale: Front-end rates and the dollar are tightening conditions before CPI, while credit and VIX have not confirmed systemic stress.

evidence.statement: The 2Y yield rose on the session as the market reduced near-term easing expectations.
DXY strengthened alongside the move in front-end yields.
The latest available HY OAS close remained broadly stable and did not confirm systemic credit stress.

source.name: FRED ICE BofA US High Yield OAS

evidence.statement: VIX remained below its precommitted stress threshold despite weaker growth equities.
QQQ underperformed SPY as real-rate-sensitive growth exposure weakened.
Recent inflation releases showed incomplete disinflation in core services.
Gold weakened as nominal yields and the dollar rose, consistent with a real-rate mechanism rather than a fresh haven bid.
MOVE was unavailable at the data cutoff and no substitute was used.

growth.label: Growth is slowing but not contracting.

employment.label: Employment is cooling gradually rather than breaking.

policy.label: Policy expectations are repricing toward higher for longer.

liquidity.label: No direct liquidity shock is confirmed.

rates.label: Front-end yields are rising faster than risk assets can absorb.

term_premium.label: Term-premium pressure is present but not the dominant impulse.

credit.label: Credit has not confirmed systemic stress; official OAS is lagged.

volatility.label: Equity volatility is contained, but Treasury volatility data are incomplete.

usd.label: The dollar is tightening global financial conditions at the margin.

commodity_shock.label: No independent commodity inflation or haven shock is confirmed.

equity_breadth.label: Rate-sensitive growth is underperforming without broad capitulation.

event_window.thesis: The market is leaving a clean-disinflation phase and waiting for CPI to determine whether higher-for-longer receives full pricing authority.

confirmation_conditions.description: A hot CPI is followed by higher 2Y yields and weaker rate-sensitive equities.
confirmation_conditions.observable: CPI surprise plus 2Y and QQQ response
confirmation_conditions.threshold: hot CPI; 2Y higher; QQQ relative weakness persists

invalidation_conditions.description: A benign CPI produces a sustained fall in 2Y yields without credit deterioration.
invalidation_conditions.observable: CPI surprise, 2Y yield and HY credit
invalidation_conditions.threshold: benign CPI; 2Y lower; HY OAS stable or narrower

short_1_10d.thesis: Higher front-end rates are the leading short-term pressure, but stable credit keeps the move in orderly repricing rather than crisis territory.

confirmation_conditions.description: Rates, the dollar and growth-equity underperformance remain aligned for two closes.

invalidation_conditions.description: The 2Y and dollar reverse while breadth improves without a credit shock.
invalidation_conditions.observable: 2Y, DXY, equity breadth and HY OAS
invalidation_conditions.threshold: rates and dollar lower; breadth higher; HY OAS not wider

medium_1_3m.thesis: The medium-term outcome depends on whether sticky inflation persists while growth and employment continue to cool.

confirmation_conditions.description: Inflation remains above trend while growth and employment measures weaken across multiple releases.
confirmation_conditions.observable: core inflation, payrolls, unemployment and activity surveys
confirmation_conditions.threshold: sticky core inflation plus broad growth cooling

invalidation_conditions.description: Core inflation resumes broad disinflation without a material deterioration in growth or credit.
invalidation_conditions.observable: core inflation breadth, activity and HY OAS
invalidation_conditions.threshold: broad disinflation; activity stable; HY OAS contained

market_pricing.dominant_narrative: The market is repricing toward higher for longer ahead of CPI.
competing_narratives: A growth slowdown will eventually force easing.
The current rate move is an orderly pre-event hedge rather than a durable phase change.
market_pricing.priced_policy_path: Near-term easing expectations have been reduced, but a full renewed tightening cycle is not priced.

what_would_change_the_narrative.description: A benign CPI is accepted by rates and credit rather than faded after the first reaction.
what_would_change_the_narrative.threshold: benign CPI; 2Y lower; HY OAS stable; growth relative strength improves

cross_asset_observations.name: HY_OAS

source.name: FRED ICE BofA US High Yield OAS

cross_asset_observations.interpretation: Credit has not confirmed a systemic risk phase.

cross_asset_observations.name: GOLD
cross_asset_observations.interpretation: Gold is used only to distinguish a real-rate move from a haven shock.

cross_asset_observations.name: BTC
cross_asset_observations.interpretation: BTC is a secondary high-beta sensor and does not define the macro regime by itself.

next_event.name: US CPI
next_event.priced_policy_path_before: The market has reduced near-term easing but has not fully priced renewed tightening.

scenarios.label: Hot core inflation with firm services
scenarios.condition: Core CPI is at least 0.1 percentage point above consensus and the services composition is firm without a favorable revision.

first_order.expected_move: Near-term easing probability falls and the 2Y yield rises.
first_order.rationale: The surprise directly raises the expected policy path.

second_order.expected_move: DXY firms, real yields rise and rate-sensitive growth underperforms; credit may initially remain orderly.
second_order.rationale: Higher discount rates propagate into duration and global dollar conditions.

third_order.expected_move: If rates stay high, financing conditions tighten and earnings multiples face continued pressure.
third_order.rationale: Persistent policy repricing feeds through funding costs and risk budgets.

confirmation_conditions.description: The 2Y and dollar hold their first-order move while QQQ remains weak relative to SPY.

invalidation_conditions.description: The 2Y fully reverses despite an unrevised hot core print and credit does not deteriorate.

scenarios.label: In-line headline with mixed composition
scenarios.condition: Headline and core are near consensus, with no decisive broadening or favorable revision.

first_order.expected_move: The initial rates move is limited or two-sided.
first_order.rationale: The release does not force a large change in the policy path.

second_order.expected_move: Markets return to growth, supply and positioning drivers.
second_order.rationale: Without a data surprise, existing positioning determines the reaction.

third_order.expected_move: The mixed transition persists until the next labor or inflation release.
third_order.rationale: The event does not resolve the growth-inflation conflict.

confirmation_conditions.description: Rates, credit and equity breadth remain inside their pre-event ranges.
confirmation_conditions.observable: 2Y range, HY credit and equity breadth

invalidation_conditions.description: A large cross-asset move reveals that the composition or revisions were not truly neutral.
invalidation_conditions.threshold: two independent buckets break pre-event ranges

scenarios.label: Broadly cool inflation with favorable composition
scenarios.condition: Core CPI is at least 0.1 percentage point below consensus, revisions are not adverse and services inflation cools.

first_order.expected_move: Near-term easing probability rises and the 2Y yield falls.
first_order.rationale: Broad disinflation lowers the expected policy path.

second_order.expected_move: DXY and real yields soften while rate-sensitive growth and breadth improve if credit stays stable.
second_order.rationale: Lower discount rates support duration when the move is not caused by a growth shock.

third_order.expected_move: A sustained benign path eases financing pressure and revives the disinflationary-growth candidate phase.
third_order.rationale: Repeated benign data can shift policy expectations and risk budgets.

confirmation_conditions.description: Lower 2Y and DXY are joined by stable credit and improving equity breadth.
confirmation_conditions.observable: 2Y, DXY, HY OAS and equity breadth
confirmation_conditions.threshold: rates and dollar lower; credit stable; breadth improving

invalidation_conditions.description: Credit widens and defensive assets dominate despite the cool print, indicating a growth scare rather than benign easing.
invalidation_conditions.observable: HY OAS, JNK/HYG relative performance and equity breadth

condition.description: The 2Y yield is higher on the session.
HY OAS and live high-yield proxies widen together.
condition.observable: HY OAS plus JNK/HYG relative performance

condition.description: VIX breaks the precommitted stress threshold and holds.

alerts.message: Macro prior is adverse into CPI, but credit and volatility do not confirm crisis conditions.
Treasury volatility data are incomplete; confidence is capped at medium.
